# W14: Full Problems I {.unnumbered}

**Dates:** Mon Nov 2 & Tue Nov 3, 2026 · 8:00–8:50 am · 12LH3004

**Syllabus modules:** 5 and 6 — applied together

## Plan

No new language features this week. Both lectures are spent solving complete problems, of the size and shape you will meet in the end-semester examination, using everything from the semester at once: arrays, functions, pointers, strings, structures, files and dynamic memory.

The emphasis is on the part that is usually skipped. Reading a problem statement and deciding what the data actually is. Choosing between an array and allocated memory. Deciding which parts become functions and what each one promises. Then writing it, and checking it against the statement rather than against a hope.

A worked problem will be developed on the board across both lectures rather than presented finished.
